title: Automatic Enrollment Requirements Under Section 414A
summary: This document sets forth final regulations that provide guidance with respect to the automatic enrollment requirements that apply to certain retirement plans. The regulations reflect statutory changes made by the SECURE 2.0 Act of 2022 requiring that certain cash or deferred arrangements and salary reduction agreements be eligible automatic contribution arrangements that satisfy additional specified requirements. The regulations affect participants in, beneficiaries of, employers maintaining, and administrators of certain retirement plans that include cash or deferred arrangements or annuity contracts purchased under salary reduction agreements and other retirement plans that include eligible automatic contribution arrangements.
